-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/jdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/jdep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/jdep"
)

func main() {
	out, err := json.Marshal(map[string]int{"a": 1})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
	dep.Init()
}

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/jdep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "reflect"

type Plugin struct{}

func (p *Plugin) Run() string { return "run" }

//go:noinline
func Init() { layer1() }

//go:noinline
func layer1() { layer2() }

//go:noinline
func layer2() { layer3() }

//go:noinline
func layer3() { layer4() }

//go:noinline
func layer4() {
	m := reflect.ValueOf(&Plugin{}).Method(0)
	_ = m.Call(nil)
}

	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ddep"

	if err != nil {

-- d/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/ddep

go 1.27

-- d/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "encoding/json"

//go:noinline
func Count() int {
	var m map[string]int
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"x":1}`), &m); err != nil {
		return -1
	}
	return len(m)
}

-- f/main/go.mod --
module example.com/fmain

go 1.27

-- f/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- f/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fmain/inner"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(inner.Encode(map[string]int{"f": 2}))
}

-- f/main/inner/inner.go --
package inner

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
)

//go:noinline
func Encode(v any) string {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	}
	if reflect.ValueOf(v).Kind() != reflect.Map {
		return ""
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return string(out)
}

package dep

import "reflect"

type Plugin struct{}

func (p *Plugin) Run() string { return "run" }

func helper() {
	m := reflect.ValueOf(&Plugin{}).Method(0)
	_ = m
}

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	helper()
}
